title: 第7章 可有妙龄女子乎？
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

碰了个钉子的凝香，退后一步，不说话了。

“好！胡阿三，你很好，你给我牙都快咬碎了，“上来！”

胡阿三也不客气，直接就爬到了王海的背上。

直到王海脸憋得通红，把他背起来后，他才扭头对身后的凝香得意一笑。

凝香一愣，还以为自己眼花了，这个被欺负的可怜人，怎么笑起来好像蔫坏蔫坏的？

一刻钟后。

张宁已经来到了，比县衙还要气派的钱家大宅外。

路上，张宁拿出了前世哄女朋友的那套打法，在他的刻意向下兼容下，钱世康简直快被哄成胚胎了。

“说出来不怕兄弟笑话，那刁民的娘子，其实连中人之姿都算不上。”

钱世康甚至主动提及了，意图对胡阿三娘子不轨的事，“但钱某就好这一口，那刁民也是不识抬举，若他真肯让钱某，与他娘子共一段浮云之情，钱某又岂会在乎那区区半斗粟米？”

浮云之情，就是那个一下。

张宁早就发现了，这姓钱的肚子里明明没多少墨水，却又总爱掉两下书袋，换言之，就是挺爱装逼的。

对付这种人最简单了，只要让他装个够即可。

张宁当即后退半步，郑重作揖，“我本以为钱兄是荒山夷吾，不料钱兄竟还兼孟德雄风，恕我眼拙，请钱兄再受我一拜。”

这么爱掉书袋，总该知道夷吾就是管仲吧？

万一这败类，突然问我一句，夷吾是谁，岂不是太尴尬了？

钱世康都快乐开花了，堂堂大乾六皇子，竟如此奉承自己，这可真是……

“唉，钱某本有箕山之志，却不料竟被宁弟一眼看出。”钱世康死死压着嘴角，故作无奈道，“既如此，钱某愿为宁弟之夷吾，九合诸侯，尊王攘夷！”

张宁暗松口气，这禽兽墨水是不多，但还是有那么几滴的。

Page (1/3)

Ningxiang, who hit a wall, took a step back and stopped talking.

"Okay! Hu Asan, you're very good. My teeth are almost broken because of your teeth. "Come up!"

Hu Asan was not polite and climbed directly onto Wang Hai's back.

It wasn't until Wang Hai's face turned red from holding it back and he picked him up on his back that he turned around and smiled proudly at Ning Xiang behind him.

Ningxiang was stunned for a moment, thinking she was dazzled. Why did this poor bullied person look like he was wilted when he smiled?

A quarter of an hour later.

Zhang Ning has arrived, outside the Qian family's mansion, which is even more impressive than the county government office.

On the way, Zhang Ning used the same tactics he used to coax his girlfriend in his previous life. With his deliberate downward compatibility, Qian Shikang was almost coaxed into an embryo.

"I'm not afraid of my brothers' jokes when I say it. That unruly woman is actually not even a decent person."

Qian Shikang even took the initiative to mention his intention to cheat on Mrs. Hu Asan, "But Qian is good at this, and the unruly people don't know how to praise him. If he is really willing to let Qian have a romantic relationship with his wife, how can Qian care about a mere half a bucket of corn?""

The feeling of floating clouds is just that moment.

Zhang Ning had long discovered that Qian didn't have much ink in his stomach, but he always liked to drop his book bag. In other words, he really liked to show off.

It's easiest to deal with this kind of person, just let him pretend enough.

Zhang Ning immediately took half a step back and bowed solemnly, "I originally thought Brother Qian was a barren mountain Yiwu, but unexpectedly Brother Qian is also a man of great virtue. Forgive me for my stupidity, please accept my bow to Brother Qian again.""

If you love dropping your book bag so much, you should know that Yiwu is Guan Zhong, right?

Wouldn't it be too embarrassing if this scum suddenly asked me, who is Yiwu?

Qian Shikang was so happy that the sixth and dignified prince flattered him so much. This was really...

“Alas, Qian originally had Jishan’s ambition, but unexpectedly, Ning Di saw it at a glance.Qian Shikang pressed the corner of his mouth tightly, pretending to be helpless and said, "In that case, Qian is willing to fight against the barbarians for my brother Ning, and to unite the nine princes and respect the king to fight against the barbarians!""

Zhang Ning secretly breathed a sigh of relief. This beast didn't have much ink, but there were still a few drops.
